attchmntText: Gokul Refoils and Solvent Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Gokul Refoils and Solvent Limited Board of Directors approved the Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board meeting was held on November 14, 2026. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations was 7,220.84 lakhs. Net profit was 90.32 lakhs. Earnings per share was 0.09 rupees. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations was 9,384.51 lakhs. Net profit was 225.13 lakhs. Earnings per share was 0.23 rupees. The financial results were reviewed by M.R. Pandhi and Associates. The company also noted the conversion of a partnership firm into a public limited company on June 15, 2026.
